analysis: Change: ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift renames the autopilot gate from autopilotAllowsModel to autopilotServesModel at base/head line 135 (throwIfRefusingNewLocalWork, local admission) and line 513 (authoritative pre-accept coordinator admission check, before acceptedLifecycleRequests insert and inference_accepted at 522-523). The surrounding controls are unchanged. These include request decryption at 293-309 with a 32-byte sender key, the tool-schema metadata check, rejection of reserved metadata, coordinator-authored cacheScope at 403 (T-041 scope isolation), and the drain/MTP/deadline gates. They also include fail-closed response encryption at 798-858 (T-008) and forced usage for billing at 932-937. The definition of autopilotServesModel is not in the supplied units. Its semantics relative to autopilotAllowsModel cannot be verified. It may be broader, for example by including models that are warm but not selected, or narrower. This gate is an availability and model-placement policy check. It is not an authorization, encryption or attestation control. Line 513 still requires a resident slot when autopilotManagesResidency is set, and still requires that no autopilot command be in progress. Later code still revalidates the slot at 611 and native controls at 654. Even a semantic widening therefore does not appear to affect A-001 confidentiality, cache scoping (T-041), or TB-011 serving authorization, which the coordinator owns. Integration should check the autopilotServesModel implementation and its other callers. The goal is to confirm it does not admit models that are deselected or retiring, and that it matches the coordinator's routing expectations, since a mismatch would be an availability or reputation issue only. No security regression was identified from the visible evidence.
